title: Fisser Flitzer Alpine Coaster Fiss
name: Fisser Flitzer Alpine Coaster Fiss
kurzbeschreibung: The Fisser Flitzer on the Möseralm in Fiss: 2.2 km long alpine coaster with a 370 m elevation drop, banked turns, jungle cave, and ice cave.
beschreibung:
Overview

The action-packed alpine coaster Fisser Flitzer is located at the renowned Sommer-Funpark Fiss on the sunny Möseralm in the Tyrolean district of Landeck at an altitude of around 1,812 meters. Nestled in the multi-award-winning family paradise of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region, the 2.2-kilometer alpine coaster ranks among the most spectacular recreational attractions in the Alps. Reaching top speeds of up to 45 km/h, tobogganers whizz down from the Möseralm over 370 meters in elevation to the valley station in Fiss.

Track Layout & Adventure Stations

The rail-guided toboggan track captivates visitors with its varied and surprising course: on the rapid downhill ride, riders navigate numerous steep banked curves, rapid waves, jumps, and tunnel passages. Extra thrills are provided by imaginatively staged themed stations along the track – including a mysterious Dschungelhöhle with life-sized animals, a spooky pirate ship passage, an icy cave with frosty light effects, and a burning barn with harmless smoke and sound effects. Drivers control their own speed using ergonomic brake levers. At the end of the track, a modern speed camera clocks the pace and snaps a souvenir photo of the riders.

Visit & Getting There

The Fisser Flitzer and the Sommer-Funpark Fiss are open daily from mid-June to mid-October from 08:30 to 17:00. Single-ride ticket prices (as of the 2025/2026 season): adults approx. €10.50, youth (born 2007–2010) approx. €9.00, children (born 2011–2018) approx. €7.50, toddlers accompanied by an adult ride free (minimum age for solo riders is 8 years). Ascent to the Möseralm is comfortable aboard the Möseralmbahn. Getting there by car: Via the Inntal motorway A12 or B180 to Ried im Oberinntal, branch off onto the Serfauser Landesstraße L19 and drive up to Fiss (large gondola parking lot at the village entrance, free of charge). By public transport: ÖBB train to Landeck-Zams station, then continue with Postbus line 220 directly to the Fiss Seilbahn stop.

Tips

Combine your ride with other attractions in the Sommer-Funpark Fiss, such as the Fisser Flieger (hang-gliding simulator) or the giant swing Skyswing. On the Möseralm, the spacious mountain restaurant with its panoramic sun terrace serves traditional Tyrolean delicacies, while children can explore the giant tubing run and the climbing tower.
